311: 			);
312: 		}
313: 
314: 		OutputStream os = createOutputStream(destinationFile);
315: 		imageSink = new OutputStreamImageSink(os);
316: 		imageSink.setThumbnailParameter(param);
317: 		imageSink.setOutputFormatName(formatName);
318: 		try {
319: 			imageSink.write(img);
320: 		} finally {
321: 			os.close();
322: 		}
323: 	}
324: 
325: 	// Visible for testing only.
326: 	OutputStream createOutputStream(File destinationFile) throws IOException {
327: 		return new FileOutputStream(destinationFile);
328: 	}
329: 
330: 	/**
331: 	 * Returns the destination file of the thumbnail image.
332: 	 * <p>
333: 	 * If the final destination of the thumbnail changes in the course of
334: 	 * writing the thumbnail. (For example, if the file extension for the given
335: 	 * destination did not match the destination file format, then the correct
336: 	 * file extension could be appended.)
337: 	 * 
338: 	 * @return the destinationFile
339: 	 */
340: 	public File getSink() {
341: 		return destinationFile;
342: 	}
343: 	
344: 	public void setOutputFormatName(String format) {
345: 		this.outputFormat = format;
346: 		this.imageSink.setOutputFormatName(format);
347: 	}
348: 
349: 	public void setThumbnailParameter(ThumbnailParameter param) {
350: 		this.param = param;
351: 		this.imageSink.setThumbnailParameter(param);
352: 	}
353: }
